mapper.select:
select * from Sec_Control_Price_Please_Review
and cppr_review_matter like concat('%',#{params.cpprReviewMatter},'%')
and cppr_approval_unit like concat('%',#{params.cpprApprovalUnit},'%')
and cppr_approval_content like concat('%',#{params.cpprApprovalContent},'%')
and secId = #{params.secId}
and state = #{params.state}
and create_uname like concat('%',#{params.createUname},'%')

select sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, scppr.* from Sec_Control_Price_Please_Review scppr left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=scppr.Sec_Id where scppr.cppr_id = #{cpprId}
